title: lazy-sunday ukrainian turkey mince grill
description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring turkey mince, bell peppers, and spices, perfect for a relaxing lazy Sunday. This recipe is low in calories and can be prepared in under an hour.

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: sweet or smoked, whichever you prefer

instructions: Preheat your broiler.|Preheat your oven to 400�62F (200�68C).|In a large bowl, combine the ground turkey, minced onion, minced garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.|Add the chopped bell peppers to the bowl and mix until they are evenly distributed.|Using your hands, shape the mixture into 4-6 patties, depending on the size you prefer.|Line a broiler pan or a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray. Place the patties on the prepared pan.|Drizzle the tops with olive oil and sprinkle with feta cheese.|Broil the patties for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.|While the patties are cooking, prepare the yogurt sauce by mixing together the Greek yogurt, chopped fresh dill, and a pinch of salt.| Serve the cooked patties with the yogurt sauce spooned over the top and garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
